facts.fact: Governor Johnson Pandit Asiama told the Invest Ghana Summit that the Bank of Ghana is developing a dedicated legal and regulatory framework for fintech companies, alongside an open banking framework for consent-based data sharing.
facts.system: Bank of Ghana fintech regulatory framework

facts.fact: Governor Asiama said the Bank of Ghana is implementing guidelines for digital credit service providers to make digital lending fair, transparent and sustainable for borrowers.
facts.system: Bank of Ghana digital credit guidelines

GHA.note: Interoperability named as an agenda item only; no service or switch described.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
